QuestInfo.name: Lost Smile
QuestInfo.0: #bChief Alex#k, in #bHenesys Ruins#k, has a personal favor to ask of you.
QuestInfo.1: Jay has grown somber since the loss of Mrs. Ming Ming and Chief Stan. Get a #bCheery Book#k from #rOfficial Knight Bs#k and give it to him.
QuestInfo.2: You gave the book to Jay for Alex.

0.0: How have you been? I have a personal favor to ask of you... Have you met Jay?

yes.0: Thank you. One of my informants told me that #rOfficial Knight Bs#k of the Cygnus Knights carry the #bCheery Book#k. One paragraph from that will have you busting a gut. Please get one and give it to Jay.

no.0: I know we're fighting for survival, but we're still human. Can't you help out?

0.1: Ever since we lost our parents in the attack, I've been worried about him. He became a warlock, and all he cares about now is researching stronger and stronger magic.
0.2: Hope has returned to us now that Cygnus is defeated. Would you help me bring a smile back to his face?

1.0: Hello. How have you been? I've been doing well. Cygnus is gone, but the remnants of her army are still there. I'm keeping up my training so I can help get rid of them.

yes.0: This is from Alex? He's changed so much since we were kids... but I've always depended on him.
yes.1: Thank you very much. I'll give my thanks to Alex later. Should be a good read.

npc.0: The #rOfficial Knight Bs#k of the Cygnus Knights carry the #bCheery Book#k. That book will raise anyone's spirits. Please get one and give it to Jay.

item.0: Hello. How have you been? I've been doing well. Cygnus is gone, but the remnants of her forces are still there. I'm still training to get rid of them.
